content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 12.4 (paragraph p0051) was the only non-solicit in the agreement, and it failed the fallback on every element — one-way against Customer, covering *all* persons employed by Vendor at any time during the term, eighteen months post-termination, no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and extending to "engage" (an effective no-hire, which is walk-away territory). It also contradicted Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer made "no ... no-hire commitment."

**Redline (preferred level, validated ok:true):** a single surgical replacement flipping the prohibitory operator in 12.4 so it confirms Customer is not restricted from soliciting or engaging Vendor personnel — resolving the internal conflict with 12.3 without collateral rewrites. The comment offers the mutual 12-month involved-personnel fallback with carve-outs if Vendor needs a covenant.
